baseline: New geometry regression failed against original shipped CSS: unused 15px gutter, 7.5px left versus 22.5px right inset.
screenshotMethod: Paired screenshots reapply only the original scrollbar-gutter: stable declaration in the same native PiP, then restore shipped CSS; native bounds unchanged.
sizingDecision: No JS change: tableWidth measures metric minima; scrollbarWidth supplies authentic browser width for OpeningMeasure.read, not a persistent CSS gutter. Explicit Fit height and passive native bounds pass unchanged.
